faqs.q: Sec. 54-42. - MTC Part 17 "Penalties and procedures" amended.
faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by adding section 1705 to Part 17 to read
               as follows:
1705. Violations and Penalties.
(1)
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate any of the provisions of this article,
                  and any such violation shall be punishable as set forth herein.
(2)
Any violation set forth in
section 58-41
(a)(2) of this Code shall be a misdemeanor traffic offense. Every person convicted
                  of a misdemeanor traffic offense shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the limits
                  established in
section 1-5
of this Code or by imprisonment for not more than 180 days or by both such fine and
                  imprisonment.
(3)
Any violation not declared to be a misdemeanor traffic offense in
section 58-41
(a)(2) of this Code shall be a noncriminal traffic infraction. Every person convicted
                  of a noncriminal traffic infraction shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the
                  limits established in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(4)
The penalty imposed for any speeding violation under section 1101 of this Code shall
                  be doubled if the violation occurs within a maintenance, repair, or construction zone
                  designated pursuant to the requirements of section 614 of this Code.
(5)
The penalty imposed for any moving traffic violation committed by a person in a school
                  zone as set forth in section 615 shall be doubled.
(6)
Every day any violation of this article is committed or permitted to continue shall
                  constitute a separate offense punishable as set forth herein.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
;
Ord. No. 4452, § 2, 8-4-2014
)
